inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Must not serve identified foods to allergic child: During the course of the investigation, it was found that a child was served food containing an item from their allergy list.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Must not serve identified foods to allergic child (26 TAC §746.3301(i))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Procedures parents access minimum standards online, TX A/N hotline, and HHSC website: The operational policies did not contain information on how to access Minimum Standard Rules, the Texas Abuse hotline or the HHSC website.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Procedures parents access minimum standards online, TX A/N hotline, and HHSC website (26 TAC §746.501(a)(23))

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing: Two orbital spinners on the school age playground did not have any loose-fill or unitary surfacing under them.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt: During the investigation, it was determined that several children were not promptly changed when they had soiled or wet diapers/clothing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps- Prompt (26 TAC §746.3501(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: It was determined that a child was left unsupervised for approximately three minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: Licensing wasn't notified when it was determined a non-routine situation that placed, or may have placed, a child at risk for injury or harm when a child was able to walk down the side of the gated corridor to unlock the latch and open the exit metal gate that leads to the parking lot.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based upon a non-routine situation that placed, or may have placed, a child at risk for injury occurred when a child was unsupervised on the side of the gated corridor and unlock the latch and open the exit metal gate that leads to the parking lot.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: An incident report was not provided to the parent when a non-routine situation that placed, or may have placed, a child at risk for injury or harm when a child was able to walk down the side of the gated corridor unsupervised to unlock the latch and open the exit metal gate that leads to the parking lot.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: A Food Allergy & Anaphylaxis Care Plan (FARE) did not have the parent's signature.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children: At time of inspection, cleaning chemicals were observed at child's reach in the school aged class.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))

occurrences.finding: Corrections Made to Fire Inspection: At time of inspection, operations last fire inspection was conducted on 11.4.24 that required corrections made and have not been completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Corrections Made to Fire Inspection (26 TAC §746.5105)

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: At time of inspection one out of ten staff files had an expired CPR/First Aid certification.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: At time of inspection the grass to the school aged playground was approxiamelty 4 inches tall.  At time of inspection there was a gap in the school aged fence approximatley 3 inches.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: At time of inspection, a PreK caregiver stated class had twenty children when they had nineteen.     This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age: At time of inspection, children were not sleeping in their assigned cot in two different toddler classes .
occurrences.violation_type_title: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age (26 TAC §746.4503(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - signed dated statement that employee received operational policies: At time of inspection, ten staff files did not have verification of acknowledgment of staff and operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - signed dated statement that employee received operational policies (26 TAC §746.901(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: At the time of inspection, the director and drivers had completed only one hour of transportation training, which is below the required two hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Parental Communication - Injury Requires Treatment by Health Care Professional or Hospitalization: Throughout the investigation, it was noted that a toddler displayed signs of a possible injured finger. The child cried intermittently through out the day about their finger. The caregivers did not notify the parent of the injury. The child had a dislocated and fractured finger.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Parental Communication - Injury Requires Treatment by Health Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.307(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Critical Injury - Give First Aid or CPR: Throughout the investigation, it was noted that caregivers did not assess the child when they were crying and holding their arm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Critical Injury - Give First Aid or CPR (26 TAC §746.3607(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Caregivers exhibited lack of judgement by failing to notify the parents and their administration of a child that exhibited and expressed signs of being injured. The child had been intermittently crying for from 850AM until 5PM . The child was later diagnosed with a dislocated and fractured finger.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Three out of ten staff files reviewed were missing training over handling and  storing of hazardous materials training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: A trash can in the Pre-School 1 classroom that had diapers in it did not have a lid making it accessible to children.    This was CORRECTED AT INSPECTION when the trashcan was replaced with a new one that has a lid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers: It was determined that information regarding a child's injury was not shared with the incoming teacher.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Share Information with Incoming Caregivers (26 TAC §746.1203(10))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Arranged for Supervision: A child was on a device called the "spinning dummy" with another child and caregiver was not nearby for supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - Arranged for Supervision (26 TAC §746.4601(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: There are concerns in regard to a caregiver's tone and yelling when addressing children in her care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: The operation failed to submit a background check for a governing body designee tasked with overseeing day-to-day operations as the regional manager of the LLC that owns the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Operations school-aged playground chain link was not properly secured in which allowed a child to exit the play area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: During inspection it was observed one out of the three buses used at operation, a seatbelt was not working.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: All Adult Passengers Wear Safety Belts: During the investigation, it was determined caregivers have not worn seat belts as required when transporting children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: All Adult Passengers Wear Safety Belts (26 TAC §746.5609(b))

occurrences.finding: Child Passenger Safety Seat System-8 through12 years, can be properly secured by vehicle safety belt and 4 feet 9 inches in height or taller: During the investigation, it was determined children have not worn seat belts as required when transporting in operations buses.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System-8 through12 years, can be properly secured by vehicle safety belt and 4 feet 9 inches in height or taller (26 TAC §746.5607(e)(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During the investigation, it was verified a 20-month-old child was left unsupervised in the playground on 6.13.23.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: Operation failed to report to licensing  that a child was left unsupervised for around five minutes in the playground in the older toddlers classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: During the investigation, it was verified that on 6.13.23 caregivers did not conduct a name-to-face count in a toddler class verifying all children were present when they noticed the class back door open.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For: At the time of inspection the caregiver in the infant and toddler room did not know how many children were in her care. She stated there were 8  children in her care when there were 9 in infant room and in toddler room she stated 16 and there were 17.     The director corrected it during inspection by recounting children and rooster making sure all children were accounted for.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §746.1203(2))
